lines.t: In the stillness of the morning, the whisper fills my soul,
Your light breaks through the shadows, and broken hearts are whole.
You wore the crown of sorrows, yet peace was in Your eyes,
A promise softly spoken beneath the waking skies.
The earth stands still in wonder, the heavens call Your name,
From silence blooms salvation, eternal love remains.
YahuShua, my Redeemer, Your love restores my flame,
You breathe life through my spirit, I’ll never be the same.
From darkness into glory, You carried me anew,
Forever I’ll remember the love that flows from You.
Your truth unfolds like sunrise, Your mercy like the rain,
You heal the hearts forgotten, redeem the deepest pain.
Through every storm and struggle, Your voice is calm and true,
The Lamb once slain is risen—the light that breaks through gloom.
Creation sings Your triumph, the oceans praise Your might,
Your kingdom ever shining, the darkness turns to light.
YahuShua, my Redeemer, Your love restores my flame,
You breathe life through my spirit, I’ll never be the same.
From darkness into glory, You carried me anew,
Forever I’ll remember the love that flows from You.
When the storms are raging, I will not be afraid,
Your hands reach through the tempest; Your promise will not fade.
You lift me into freedom, where endless truth abides,
The King who reigns forever, with mercy as His guide.
YahuShua, my Redeemer, the faithful, pure, and true,
You’ve written love eternal in hearts made new by You.
All glory to the Highest, forever I’ll pursue,
The endless grace and wonder—the light that flows from You.
The light that flows from You…
